page_title: MNT 0-0 LEN | Montpellier v Lens 08/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Although Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is just on the bench, Stephanie Frappart has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+2' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

87' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Akor Adams (Montpellier) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba pulls off a comfortable save.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' The referee points to the corner flag and Lens will take a corner.
79' It is time for a substitution. Andy Diouf (Lens) is on for Neil El Aynaoui.
78' Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Lens will take a throw-in.
76' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
73' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Brice Samba intercepts the ball.
72' The referee allows time for a substitution. Elye Wahi will be replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
72' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Nampalys Mendy (Lens) replaces Salis Abdul Samed.
70' Here comes a substitution. Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) is brought on as a substitute for Enzo Tchato.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Khalil Fayad departs the field of play to be replaced by Sacha Delaye (Montpellier).
65' Here comes a substitution. Adrien Thomasson is given a rest as he is replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
65' Here is a change. David Costa is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
63' Akor Adams (Montpellier) gets inside the box and tries to beat Brice Samba with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

60' He should have scored! Elye Wahi (Lens) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Benjamin Lecomte makes an easy save.

60' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) gets the ball from a rebound before trying his luck with a good long-range shot which threatens the goalkeeper! The ball sails painfully wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
56' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
56' Michel Der Zakarian is forced to make a change. Mousa Al Tamari is unable to continue due to injury, Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) comes on.
51' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Lens are taking a throw-in.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' David Costa (Lens) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
45+3' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

38' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Elye Wahi (Lens) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
38' David Costa (Lens) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

37' A pass travels right across the box to Elye Wahi (Lens) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the right post, but Benjamin Lecomte denies him with a decent save. It will be a corner kick for Lens.
35' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
33' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

32' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Enzo Tchato (Montpellier), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

29' Close! Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.

26' David Costa (Lens) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
26' Elye Wahi (Lens) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
24' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Akor Adams (Montpellier), but the defence gets it clear.
22' Montpellier seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
16' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Montpellier have a corner.
15' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) for his blatant foul.
12' Kevin Danso (Lens) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.

10' It looked like the long-range shot by Joris Chotard (Montpellier) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
8' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
7' The ball is cleared after Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Montpellier manage to earn a corner.
2' Neat passing move from Lens in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Montpellier will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Stephanie Frappart.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
